## 🚀 GETTING STARTED

### View the Game
The enhanced UI is ready to use. All panels appear automatically when the game runs:

1. **Agent Info** (top-left) - See all agent conditions at a glance
2. **Task Checklist** (left side) - Track tasks by agent with color coding
3. **Map Legend** (bottom-left) - Reference all tile types
4. **Turn Timeline** (bottom-right) - See progress through 50 turns
5. **Statistics** (bottom-right) - View real-time game metrics
6. **Tooltips** (hover anywhere) - Get instant information

## 🔍 QUICK FEATURE OVERVIEW

### Enhanced Agent Info Panel
```
Shows for each agent:
  ⚡ Special Agent status (with charge count)
  🏥 Injury status (if injured)
  ⚖️ Criminal status (if arrested, with jail countdown)
  📷 Photo taking status (if taking photo, with turns left)
  📍 Current location coordinates
  ⏱️ Turns remaining (e.g., 25/50)
```

### Task Checklist
```
Color coding:
  ✅ Green = Task completed
  ⏳ Yellow = Currently working on task
  ☐ Gray = Not yet started
Grouped by agent for easy tracking
```

### Map Legend
```
Categories:
  🛣️ Roads (gray)
  🏪 Services (blue)
  🏛️ Landmarks (gold)
All tiles shown with icons and names
```

### Turn Timeline
```
Visual progress bar showing:
  • Current turn number
  • Maximum turn number
  • Percentage complete
  • Color gradient (blue→green)
```

### Statistics Panel
```
Real-time counters:
  • Total tasks completed (all agents)
  • Photo delays (cumulative turns)
  • Congestion incidents (affected tiles)
  • Abilities used (roadblocks placed)
Updates every turn automatically
```

### Tooltips
```
Hover over any tile to see:
  • Position coordinates
  • Tile type and icon
  • Walkability status
  • Congestion level
  
Hover over any agent to see:
  • Agent ID and status
  • Current location
  • Turns remaining
  • Active conditions
```
